column1: # launchers.tsv — the image's launcher inventory, read by test_launcher_icon_coverage.py: every .desktop file under
# /usr/share/applications of the installed R001.3 candidate (-02), with the Icon=, NoDisplay= and Hidden= keys of its
# [Desktop Entry] group and the package that owns it (pkm provides), read read-only from that install on 2026-10-17,
# 129 files. com.google.Chrome.desktop is written by the chrome download helper outside the package manifest, so it is
# listed under that helper's recipe. Re-read it from an installed image whenever the image's launcher set changes.
